title: Canonicalize Target Graphql Operation Fields
description: Clean semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql operation field names so operation API names are action-first, e.g. createdDesign instead of designCreated.
summary: Changed every Operation.scope field in semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql to Entity references with # reference comments listing allowed scope entity kinds. Operation interface now documents the broad scope set; concrete operations document narrowed references.
